items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: I was taking the guitar and asked the piano player, would he mind me trying to learn a little bit? ... He showed me.

ctx.x: Piano player and a guitar player. My twin sister was. And five more of my other sisters mostly played pianos. See in all, there's 15 of us in all. Fifteen? Fifteen whole sisters and brothers. And so.
Say what was your first instrument that you ever played?
